checkpoints.location: Interregional Trainer Licensing Center — Certification Arena
checkpoints.summary: Luke and Hisuian Growlithe won the supervised starter-only certification battle against Mattew and Eevee in round 7. Growlithe finished at 1/35 HP; Eevee was KO'd by Ember.

checkpoints.location: Interregional Trainer Licensing Center — Exit Hall
checkpoints.summary: Luke completed certification, received an active Trainer's License, Growlithe recovered after the first official victory, and free roam opened on World Day 1.

checkpoints.location: Nearest city — outside the cleared warehouse
checkpoints.summary: Luke and Hisuian Growlithe cleared the warehouse, carried out the bodies of two Rattata and one Raticate, and received the agreed ₽900 reward.
Luke brought Hisuian Growlithe to the city Pokécenter after JOB-02. Growlithe healed from 13/35 to 35/35 HP; PP was unchanged.

Luke saved during lunch at Mercato delle Arcate with Mattew, Daniel and Fab. Growlithe is 35/35 HP; Luke has ₽1,900. Edward is traveling toward Fattoria del Vento. Mattew has JOB-01; Edward has JOB-03. Luke has a Bulbasaur lead through Ranger Elio Mar / Borgo Salice.
